design_description: A bright candy-inspired Halloween tournament jersey, combining turquoise, chocolate brown and hot pink with playful retro graphics. The upper section uses a dripping chocolate effect across the shoulders and sleeves, with the drips running down into the body at uneven lengths and covered with colourful sprinkle details scattered across the brown. The turquoise body contrasts sharply with sweeping pink, white and teal candy-stripe waves rising from the hem, mixed with oversized round sweets and black-and-white checkerboard accents that break up the curves and add a retro arcade feel. The back continues the same chocolate-drip and candy landscape, keeping the shoulders brown and the lower body busy with sweets, finished with a large dark brown number outlined in pink and white so it stays readable against the crowded background. Overall it is intentionally fun, loud and costume-like, using Halloween through a candy and sweets theme rather than traditional horror imagery. Every element is oversized and high-contrast, making the kit unmistakable on the pitch and well suited to a one-off tournament rather than a standard season shirt.
